production_blockers.title: Production partition and acquisition runners implemented
production_blockers.detail: The production partition-manifest runner is implemented as --production-build-manifest and the production acquisition runner is implemented as --production-acquire. Previous independent reviews BLOCKed the paths; the latest remediation closes public partition dependency injection so its public runner accepts only output_path, while the second remediation hardens the acquisition boundary, Git-HEAD trust-anchor read, fixed dates, and exact JPX/Yahoo origins. It awaits independent retest.
production_blockers.blocks: independent critical review retest before any real network authorization

production_blockers.title: Acquisition bound to a trusted, validated partition manifest
production_blockers.detail: acquire_historical_block_bundle() accepts only output_root, block, and partition_manifest_path. It first verifies the canonical repository clean/HEAD==local origin state, then reads V8_TRUSTED_PARTITION.json bytes from that verified Git HEAD, requires authorization, and validates a persisted self-hash-verified production partition manifest. Its SHA256 and partition_implementation_git_commit must exactly match the anchor; source reproduction must PASS and source metadata must be exact JPX HTTPS origin. It then verifies identity/T1-T2/300-ticker/hash binding and records canonical implementation_git_commit provenance.
required_checks_before_first_network_req: git fetch origin completed by the operator immediately before the production command, with remote SHA recorded
canonical V8_TRUSTED_PARTITION.json bytes loaded from the verified Git HEAD and authorization verification
manifest SHA256 and partition implementation commit match the trusted anchor
requested block is exactly T1 or T2
tickers sourced only from partition_manifest.block_assignments[block], never from CLI/user input
computed ticker_list_sha256 matches manifest.t1_ticker_list_sha256 or t2_ticker_list_sha256
acquisition_manifest.partition_manifest_sha256 derived from the verified real manifest, never passed freely
production_blockers.additional_future_work: a separate human gate must pin a real production manifest SHA256 and partition implementation commit only after real partition creation; current authorization remains false

source_of_truth_priority: immutable/raw acquisition manifests and their hashes (once they exist)
